producer: Optional coordinate observation in the shared declaration-printing fold; direct-JS stage uses the actual stack-safe printer result and side table together. Legacy printing collects no spans and does not measure text.
coordinates: CRLF counts once; isolated CR, LF, U+2028 and U+2029 advance a line. Supplementary code points contribute two UTF-16 columns. Internal cursor state handles CRLF across chunks, but exposed declaration boundaries cannot split CRLF.
validation: Exact JsIR declaration order and complete inventory, nonempty ordered non-overlapping emitted chunks.
Every endpoint is a UTF-8 boundary with exact ECMAScript line and UTF-16 column in the actual output text, checked with one linear scan.
Exact target IR, generated JS and table ArtifactIds are pinned in the map; archive replay reconstructs the whole map.
unmapped: All code outside declaration chunks, including the shared runtime prelude, remains unmapped. A chunk includes code emitted for a declaration and is not an expression-level location or source attribution.
compatibility: Historical selected compilers and one-output print records may omit position products. Invalid present products reject their requested emission/debug product, while kernel acceptance remains a separate live capability.
remaining: Compose exact declaration origin, erasure, specialization and target identities
Emit ECMA-426 mappings with explicit unmapped generated code
Finer expression and synthetic helper origin events
